name: News Flash
description: Big, centered broadcast news-flash graphic with title and optional subtitle.

title.title: Flash Headline
title.description: Primary large headline displayed in the centered news-flash box

subtitle.title: Subtitle (Optional)
subtitle.description: Optional secondary bar below the main headline (leave empty for single-bar flash)

autoOut.title: Auto-Animate Out
autoOut.description: When enabled, the news-flash automatically animates out after Hold Duration seconds

holdDuration.title: Hold Duration (Seconds)
holdDuration.description: Seconds to remain on screen before automatically animating out (when Auto-Animate Out is enabled)

primaryColor.title: Primary Box Color
primaryColor.description: Base hex color for the main headline box gradient

secondaryColor.title: Subtitle Box Color
secondaryColor.description: Base hex color for the subtitle box gradient

accentColor.title: Accent Swipe Color
accentColor.description: Base hex color for the left accent bar and swipe wipers
